Paraa Safari Lodge · North bank of the Victoria Nile, Murchison Falls National Park, Uganda

Paraa Safari Lodge

Paraa works because it sits close to the main Murchison activity rhythm: early game drives, river launches, and short hops to the ferry and park tracks.

Destination setting: Serengeti National Park. This is not a photograph of the accommodation.

Photos: Giles Laurent (CC BY-SA 4.0). Displayed images may be resized or cropped. Photo details.

Why stay here

A practical Nile-side lodge for travelers combining boat safaris, falls visits, and northern-bank game drives.

Ask whether your itinerary needs the north or south bank. The wrong bank can add avoidable ferry timing and road transfer pressure.

Key amenities

  • Nile-side base
  • Game-drive access
  • Boat safari access
  • Swimming pool
